correctness.rationale: With fixed m,r,k,lambda>0, fixed inoculum one, c>0 co-scaling saturation and disease mortality, the implicit horizon T solves mT+c integral_0^T[x V/(1+lambda cV)]dt=1 uniquely since derivative m+cF>0. The ODE bound d(log V)/dt<=g(x)=9/2-(x-10)^2/20 gives V<=exp(g(x)t) and T<=1/m, hence Kc<=K0 uniformly all x>=0,p in [0,1]. K0 uniquely maximizes at x=10 with strict sign and uniform negative curvature. Uniform C2 compact perturbation and derivative signs make one critical maximizer on any fixed [0,R], while the global K0(R)<K0(10) gap excludes unbounded tails. This yields unique global x_c(p)=10+O(c), q_c(x_c(p))/c=10m J(9/2,1/m)+O(c), and optimized Kc=K0(10,p)+O(c), all uniform p including endpoints.
